description: [RETRIEVE — use freely, any time] Use when the user asks to recall, search, find, or look up previous memory, context, or decisions. Read-only: the call leaves the memory store byte-identical (disclosed exceptions: the hosted server's per-credential activity record). Usage counters and any feedback ratings are queued and recorded after the call: before the next write tool (waits at most ~1.5 s), by a 30 s background flush, or when the stdio server's stdin closes or it receives SIGTERM/SIGINT. A crash (kill -9, power loss) before then loses them.

feedback.description: Rate previous recall results to improve future ranking. Applied AFTER this call (queued; flushed before the next write tool, by the 30 s background flush, or on stdin close or SIGTERM/SIGINT): it never changes this call's results, and a crash (kill -9, power loss) before the next flush loses it. Pass {id, useful:true} for each result you actually used; {id, useful:false} for noise.

useful.description: Was this result useful? true=boost, false=penalize in future recalls.

since.description: ISO date ("2026-05-01") or relative duration ("7d"). Filters journal results.
